messages:
sam: Heads-up: customers reporting intermittent 502s on /api/generate in prod-eu since ~23:50 UTC. Root cause looks like a header-parsing race on long client headers. I pushed a small guard (sha: 7e8f9ab). Requesting expedited deploy in tonight's 00:30-01:00 UTC window.

deploybot: Deploy request queued for redwood/api:hotfix-7e8f9ab. Default canary: 10% for 5m -> 100% if healthy. Reply +1 to approve.
maria (release-manager): +1. Locking 00:30-01:00 UTC window. No DB changes. Prep rollback cmds and watch LB errors.
tony (sre): +1. Rollback ready. Two quick options below. I'll stand by with cluster creds.

Rollback (image-swap fast revert):
```bash
kubectl set image deployment/api api=redwood/api:main -n prod-eu && kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n prod-eu
```

Rollback (rollout undo):
```bash
kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n prod-eu --to-revision=512
```

jen (qa): Staging smoke passed. I'll watch 5xx, p95, and token-encoding errors during canary. Draft release note: https://docs.internal/release/notes/7e8f9ab-draft

deploybot: Canary started at 00:33 UTC (10% traffic). Metrics: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=canary

sam: +2m into canary: small spike in 502s; investigating traces. Tagging @tony.
tony: I see a header parse exception trace at the ingress -> upstream. Aborting canary and rolling back now.
deploybot: Aborting promotion. Initiating rollback to redwood/api:main.

deploybot: Rollback started... rollout status: success. Canary aborted at +3m.
maria: Good catch. We need a follow-up build that adds a tighter sanitizer; sam please cut a new hotfix image and request a re-deploy. Record incident brief for post-mortem.
sam: New build pushed: redwood/api:hotfix-7e8f9ab-2 (sha: 8f0b2c3). I fixed an extra edge-case in the sanitizer and added an extra unit test. Requesting redeploy with an accelerated canary: 20% for 3m -> 100%.
maria: +1 for redeploy. Accelerated canary approved.
tony: +1. I'll be ready to rollback quickly.

deploybot: Redeploy queued for redwood/api:hotfix-8f0b2c3. Emergency canary started 00:46 UTC at 20% traffic. Observability: https://console.redwood/metrics/prod-eu?job=hotfix-emergency

jen: +2m into emergency canary: no 5xx spike, p95 stable, KV hit-rate normal.
sam: traces show header sanitizer path executing as expected. No parse exceptions.
maria: Hold one more minute for long-lived sessions, then promote if still clean.
deploybot: Promoting to 100% traffic at 00:50 UTC... promotion complete. All pods updated. ✅
tony: Dashboards green. No pod restarts, latency and error budget within SLO.
jen: Final smoke passed. Published release note: "Hotfix 8f0b2c3: stricter header sanitizer to prevent intermittent 502s in EU; rollback executed during first canary and redeploy with accelerated canary." Link: https://docs.internal/redwood/release-notes/8f0b2c3
maria: Signed off and closing the hotfix window. Filing a short incident note and lessons learned. If anything happens roll back using commands above and ping #eng-oncall. Thanks all. :party_parrot:
sam: Thanks everyone — good teamwork.
